column1: # HA firmware on epdInky ESP32-P4/C6 rev.2 (TFT+touch variant) - partition table
# Flash is 16 MB (W25Q128JVS). No OTA slots: this v1 example has no update
# mechanism - reflash over USB to update. No SD-card storage either - the
# dashboard is a compiled-in tile list and a live WebSocket connection
# there's nothing to cache between boots beyond what NVS already holds
# The factory app slot is larger than the e-paper firmware's: LVGL
# WebSocket client and cJSON add real code size on top of the same Wi-Fi/BLE
